7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Grey clouds hung low on the horizon. A strong wind was picking up, and waves crashed violently on the rocky cliffs below me.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Grey clouds hung low on the horizon. A strong wind was picking up, and waves crashed violently on the rocky cliffs below me.
8.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

9.speaker: Vina Toras
9.text: "A half-brother. I suppose congratulations are in order."

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: She ran a hand along the terrace's gold-plated railing.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: The future king of Rizia. At least as the law would have it.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: I'd met Vina here to tell her privately before informing the world. As I looked at her stony expression, I wondered if I had made a mistake.

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "I know that this is a lot to take in."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "Please. At least try to be happy for me."

21.speaker: Vina Toras
21.text: "I've based my entire life on the idea that I was the future queen of Rizia."

22.speaker: Vina Toras
22.text: "I spent so many hours attending council meetings..."

29.speaker: Vina Toras
29.text: "I went to so many balls and etiquette classes..."

30.speaker: Vina Toras
30.text: "I gave up the chance to be with the man I loved..."

34.speaker: Vina Toras
34.text: "I let you talk me into marrying my own cousin, because you said that was what was expected of the heir to House Toras!"

35.speaker: Vina Toras
35.text: "All while you went about consolidating your power, even getting rid of the House of Delegates to keep yourself and your... son in charge."
35.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Monarchy_Absolute"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false)

39.speaker: Vina Toras
39.text: "I went to Pales as the heiress to the Rizian throne, and we all know what happened there..."
39.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true)

46.speaker: Vina Toras
46.text: "All while you went about making life miserable for the commoners. To the point of mass unrest."
46.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Monarchy_Absolute"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false)

48.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
48.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Involve_Vina"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == false

49.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
49.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Involve_Vina"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == false) == false

50.speaker: Vina Toras
50.text: "All while you went about making reforms that I suggested without even consulting me on them."
50.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Monarchy_Absolute"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Involve_Vina"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false)

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: She wrapped her kerchief tighter around her head as a gust of wind blew.
51.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Monarchy_Absolute"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Involve_Vina"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) == false)

52.speaker: Vina Toras
52.text: "Tell me, Father. What was it all for?"

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "Vina. Don't you remember when we were sitting down there on the beach and I warned you that exactly this might happen?"

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "Nothing is set in stone. In fact, I would prefer that you succeed me."

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "I haven't forgotten what I told you down there on the beach long ago. Rizia's succession laws need not stay in place."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "Listen. I would love to name you my successor. But it's not as easy as that."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "What the hell, Vina? You go on and on about wanting change, and now you're begging to be named successor to a position that doesn't even hold weight anymore?"

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: Her eyes brimmed over with fury. She opened her mouth to retaliate, then shut it and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: Her eyes brimmed over with fury. She stalked away and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

78.speaker: Narrator
78.text: She froze and looked up at me cautiously.

84.speaker: Vina Toras
84.text: "You already broke the rules on my behalf once. I won't ask you to do it twice."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: She froze and looked up at me cautiously.

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "Yes. Lucita and I are in love and having a child together. Whether that child takes the throne doesn't matter to us."

88.speaker: Vina Toras
88.text: "What's so complicated? You've changed enough laws at this point..."

93.speaker: Narrator
93.text: Her eyes brimmed over with fury. She stalked away and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: She walked a few steps away and sat down heavily on the nearest settee.

99.speaker: Vina Toras
99.text: "My darling husband doesn't give a damn whether he's Crown Prince Consort or not. But his family does."

100.speaker: Vina Toras
100.text: "My darling husband married me with the expectation that his children would inherit the throne of Rizia."

101.speaker: Vina Toras
101.text: "If that doesn't happen... well, I don't see the Rizia-Pales reunion lasting for very long."

102.speaker: Vina Toras
102.text: "You favored them greatly by returning Zille to Brenas. Name me your heir, and you'll have their loyalty forever."

106.speaker: Vina Toras
106.text: "Whether or not it's symbolic is of no consequence."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "You're underestimating the threat of House Azaro. If I rob my son of his birthright, it'll be both of our heads on the chopping block."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "Tradition is tradition. Your partner and his family will just have to respect that."

113.speaker: Vina Toras
113.text: "I am the Duchess of Valenqiris. The only person House Toras loves more than me is Rico."
113.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true)

121.speaker: Vina Toras
121.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true)

122.speaker: Vina Toras
122.text: "If I'm removed as heir to the throne, there'll be hell to pay from my province."
122.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true) == false)

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "You don't even have any marriage prospects. You're as barren as a fig tree in winter."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "You can cajole and threaten all you want. It's not going to change my mind."

129.speaker: Vina Toras
129.text: "I know. But if you love me, at least think about what I'm saying."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "Your arguments make sense. I am weighing my options carefully."

131.speaker: Vina Toras
131.text: "I am the wife of Rico Toras. Our house is expecting our bloodline to keep the throne. No Azaros invited."
131.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false)

135.speaker: Vina Toras
135.text: "If I'm removed as heiress, there'll be hell to pay from Valenqiris."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "The Royal Council reshuffle is coming up. What if I gave you a promotion?"

138.speaker: Vina Toras
138.text: "It's not his birthright if you change the law."

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: She paused, then shook her head.

148.speaker: Vina Toras
148.text: "Even if the throne is only symbolic at this point."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "Yes, but I'm still weighing my options. It's complicated."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "I know what a good monarch you'll be. You deserve it."

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: She gave me a grateful half-smile.

152.speaker: Vina Toras
152.text: "But what about House Azaro? I'm sure they'll be furious if their heir isn't named successor."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "Your Aunt Bea would have my nether parts on a guillotine if I removed Rumburgian blood from the line of succession."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "I can't take your mother's blood out of the line of succession. I owe her that much."

159.speaker: Vina Toras
159.text: "I shouldn't sit on a council all my life like Ms. Werner. I should *have* a council."

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: Her head whipped towards the door. Lucita had come to fetch me.

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "Leave me to deal with the Azaros."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "That's a good point. This won't be an easy decision to make."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "The Azaros aren't the only player on this chess board. Don't forget about your beau."

167.speaker: Vina Toras
167.text: "If they retaliate, I'll be the one they go after first."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "You're thinking in such medieval terms. All three of Rizia's noble houses should be able to live in peace together."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "You're the one who wants to be queen. Are you willing to spend the rest of your life looking over your shoulder?"

172.speaker: Vina Toras
172.text: "Ideally, yes. Some of these people seem to have no idea it's 1957."

173.speaker: Vina Toras
173.text: "Yes, of course he and his family are a factor."

175.speaker: Vina Toras
175.text: "You're running out of time to make it."

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: Her belly was straining the confines of her gown. Vina curtsied to her politely.

178.speaker: Vina Toras
178.text: "Hello, Duchess Azaro. I mean, Queen Consort Azaro. Your Majesty."

180.speaker: Lucita Azaro
180.text: "They'll be ready for the announcement in five minutes, Romus."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "I don't need five minutes. I know what I'm going to say."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "Leave me to think. Both of you."

184.speaker: Narrator
184.text: My wife and my daughter both smiled with confidence, then looked at each other suspiciously.

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: Lucita took my hand and led me inside the palace. Vina followed from a distance.

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: Both my wife and daughter gave me meaningful looks before turning around and heading in.

190.speaker: Narrator
190.text: The normally spacious sitting room of Palas Toras had been filled with lighting and camera equipment, all pointed at the purple velvet divan against the back wall.

191.speaker: Narrator
191.text: Above it hung portraits of Ana Azaro and Ariana Toras.

192.speaker: Narrator
192.text: Lucita and I were seated. An assistant quickly refreshed our makeup.

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: The camerawoman counted down from five. It was time for my announcement.
193.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: I looked once more at the roiling ocean.

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: Was I ready to sever my ties with my late wife?

199.speaker: Narrator
199.text: Even if I hadn't loved Lena... was I ready to sever all ties with her?

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: What would be the cost of breaking tradition and naming our daughter as heiress?

201.speaker: Vina Toras
201.text: "The current succession law is sexist and outdated. The eldest *child* should inherit the throne, not the eldest son."

203.speaker: Vina Toras
203.text: "If you want to continue the progress Queen Lyza started, it's only natural to acknowledge the eldest *child*, not the eldest son, should inherit the throne."

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: And would it be worse than the cost of keeping it?

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: I steeled myself and headed inside.

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "That's right, another speech from your king. I hope you're not sick of me yet."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "Your King has an announcement to make."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "I hope you have all grown to love my wife Lucita as you have grown to love me."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "In the wake of our triumph in the Pales war, we have yet another achievement to announce."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Having successfully restored stability in the realm, I have news that will bring you further reassurance about the monarchy's future."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "I am pleased to tell you all that the Queen Consort is about to bear me a son."

231.speaker: Narrator
231.text: Lucita placed a hand on my shoulder and smiled for the cameras.

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "My wife's pregnancy is no secret in the realm. Now, we have discovered she is carrying a boy."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "As was promised by holy scripture, a new star rises. One whose renown will eclipse even mine."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "In a matter of weeks, a new prince shall join the ranks of House Toras."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "His name shall be Prince Romus the Second."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "His name shall be Prince Taddeus the Second."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "His name shall be Prince Valero the Second."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "I shall name him Ardos, after one of the most devout Wruhecist disciples."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "According to the traditions of this great kingdom, a monarch shall be succeeded by his or her eldest son. A woman can inherit the throne only if she has no brothers."

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "As you all know, Rizia is now a constitutional monarchy. The line of succession does not carry as much importance as it used to."

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "My daughter left us before her time. Since then, the question of who will be your ruler after I am gone has been unclear."

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "With my daughter gone forever, my son has every right to claim the title of Crown Prince."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "I will soon have two children, a son and a daughter. One of them will be your ruler after I am gone."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "Though I am overjoyed at becoming a father for the second time, I cannot neglect the inspiration my daughter Vina has been to this country and to me."
262.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true) == false)

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "I hereby declare an exception to the law. Princess Vina {RiziaDLCText.VinaLastName} will remain my successor."
263.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false)

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: "I hereby declare that from henceforth, Rizian succession law will favor a king's eldest child, whether male or female. It is time to let go of our patriarchal ways." [-5 Authority]

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "In accordance with Rizian law. I shall be succeeded by the son of Queen Consort Lucita Toras."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "In recognition of the contributions made by the honorable House Azaro to this kingdom, I am proud to officially name their new heir as my successor."

270.speaker: Narrator
270.text: Lucita's grip tightened on my shoulder. Her nails practically pierced through my suit jacket.

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "However, choosing an official successor was not an easy decision for me."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "With that in mind, choosing an official successor was not an easy decision for me."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "Choosing an official successor was not an easy decision for me."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "When I thought about whom I would want succeeding me, the answer was clear as day."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "I beg of you, my public, to recognize the heir that I name today. Rizia can ill afford another War of Succession."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "But rest assured that the Royal Family shall continue to lead Rizia through thick and thin, no matter who is at the helm."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "I hereby declare an exception to our kingdom's laws. Princess Vina Toras will remain my successor, even in exile."

285.speaker: Narrator
285.text: Lucita squeezed my shoulder. Her eyes were shining with gratitude.

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "When your new prince ascends the throne, you shall love, honor and respect him as you have me."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "Having said that, with my daughter sadly no longer eligible for the throne, my son will be the one to succeed me."
287.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Succession_FemalePrefMatrilineal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Succession_AbsolutePrimogeniture"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true)

289.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
289.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Succession_FemalePrefMatrilineal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Succession_AbsolutePrimogeniture"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true)

290.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
290.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Succession_FemalePrefMatrilineal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Succession_AbsolutePrimogeniture"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true)) == false

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "Vina, if you're watching this... come home. All is forgiven."
294.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true) == false)

295.speaker: Player_Romus
295.text: "House Toras shall hold the throne. Continuity shall prevail."
295.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true) == false)

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "Upon my death, the honorable House Sazon will be the new steward of the throne. Signifying that Rizia has healed at last."
302.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true) == false)

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "Upon my death, the honorable Reinhart family will be the new steward of the throne. Signifying that Rizia and Pales are one kingdom at last."
303.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true)

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "When Vina returns to Rizia and ascends the throne, you shall love, honor and respect her as you have me."
304.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true)

305.speaker: Narrator
305.text: Lucita's grip relaxed. She smiled again.

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "From a very young age, my daughter has possessed the determination and compassion that it takes to rule this country. I have no doubt she will be an excellent Queen."

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "This may not be easy for some of you to accept. But times are changing, and Rizia must change with them."

310.speaker: Player_Romus
310.text: "If my son possesses half the intelligence and keen judgement of his mother, he will be one of the finest kings Rizia has ever known."

311.speaker: Player_Romus
311.text: "I nonetheless regret that my now-absent daughter will never sit on the throne she was meant to inherit."
311.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true

313.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
313.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true

314.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
314.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "I hope that our long-term allies in Rumburg will accept this decision. It was meant not as a slight against my late wife Lena, but as a proud adherence to the values both of our kingdoms hold dear."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "As we have made a break with Rumburg and GRACE, it seems only fitting that our former patrons will no longer have a place in the Rizian line of succession."

321.speaker: Player_Romus
321.text: "I will stress that Princess Vina Toras is equally deserving of the crown, if not more so. But I must follow the same rules that my ancestors have before me."
321.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: I heard a flurry of steps from the other end of the room, then the sound of a door closing. Vina had left.
322.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

324.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
324.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

325.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
325.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

326.speaker: Narrator
326.text: I could tell my wife was having trouble keeping a calm demeanor. I had to wrap this up.

327.speaker: Narrator
327.text: The camerawoman signaled for me to wrap things up.
327.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "Regardless of who succeeds me, your queen and I are so excited to start a family together."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "To my loyal allies in House Azaro, I know this announcement will come as a disappointment. Please know that it was not meant as a slight against you."

335.speaker: Player_Romus
335.text: "From Ariana to Lyza, the Toras family has a history of strong female rulers. Now, there shall be many more to come."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "To my family members. Rest assured that though her name has changed, Vina shall always be a Toras at heart."
339.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)

340.speaker: Player_Romus
340.text: "First Valero, then myself, now my son. The line of Toras kings shall be unbroken."

341.speaker: Player_Romus
341.text: "Rest assured this will not affect our reunification with Pales. If need be, I shall marry my son to a Palesian noblewoman."

342.speaker: Vina Toras
342.text: "Your son and his heirs will bear the Toras name. My children won't. It makes sense for our family."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "Vina, if you're watching this... the pressure on you is over. You can do anything you like, marry anyone you like. Forgive me."

347.speaker: Player_Romus
347.text: "Your queen and I are so excited to begin this new chapter."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "With a Toras and an Azaro on the throne and a Sazon married to the Princess, Rizia's three houses are united once more."

359.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
359.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)

360.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
360.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)) == false

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "Our kingdom of God will be that much greater with my son at the helm."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "All glory to your current and future queens!"

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "All hail your current and future King!"

371.speaker: Player_Romus
371.text: "Thank you and God bless you all."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "Thank you and God bless you all."

375.speaker: Narrator
375.text: The same kind of storm had almost killed my daughter all those years ago. I had come so close to losing her then.

376.speaker: Narrator
376.text: Now, she was on the verge of losing everything.

377.speaker: Narrator
377.text: The same kind of storm had almost killed my daughter all those years ago. I had come so close to losing her then.

378.speaker: Narrator
378.text: I wondered if I had lost her now.

382.speaker: Narrator
382.text: Now, I had lost her for real.

383.speaker: Narrator
383.text: The future king of Rizia. At least as the law would have it.

384.speaker: Narrator
384.text: Vina was missing. For all anyone knew, she was dead. My son was very likely my only possible heir.

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: Vina was dead. My son was my only possible heir.

389.speaker: Narrator
389.text: But by naming him as such, would I be severing ties with my daughter for good?

390.speaker: Narrator
390.text: But by speaking the words out loud, would I be severing ties with my daughter's memory?

391.speaker: Narrator
391.text: Lucita came out to fetch me. Her belly strained the confines of her gown.

393.speaker: Player_Romus
393.text: "I am their King. They can wait for me."

394.speaker: Player_Romus
394.text: "Let's go. It's cold out here anyway."

395.speaker: Player_Romus
395.text: "I still don't know what I'm going to say."

396.speaker: Lucita Azaro
396.text: "A new prince means new hope for the kingdom. This will be easy."

398.speaker: Narrator
398.text: She took my hand and led me inside.

400.speaker: Narrator
400.text: Vina was watching intensely from an armchair in the corner.
400.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

402.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
402.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

403.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
403.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

405.speaker: Narrator
405.text: We stared out at the ocean together for a couple of minutes. When I was ready, we headed inside.

409.speaker: Vina Toras
409.text: "They still haven't forgiven you for their house losing Zille. If they lose their claim to the throne too, there'll be hell to pay from Brenas."

413.speaker: Narrator
413.text: Vina was still a captive of the Palesians. For all anyone knew, she was dead. My son was very likely my only possible heir.

414.speaker: Player_Romus
414.text: "I hereby declare an exception to our kingdom's laws. When she is rescued from Pales, Princess Vina will be my successor."
414.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false)

424.speaker: Player_Romus
424.text: "I had always assumed my daughter would succeed me on the throne. Now that she has passed from this world, I know she would be happy to see that the Toras line continues."

428.speaker: Player_Romus
428.text: "With my daughter still missing, my son has every right to claim the title of Crown Prince."
428.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == true) == false)

438.speaker: Vina Toras
438.text: "All while you went about on your holy crusade, even getting rid of the Royal Council to keep yourself and your... son in charge."
438.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true)

439.speaker: Vina Toras
439.text: "My darling fiance doesn't give a damn whether he's Crown Prince Consort or not. But his family does."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "I hereby declare that from henceforth, Rizia will change to a matrilineal succession system. Eldest daughters, not eldest sons, will inherit the throne." [-6 Authority]

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "When Vina ascends the throne, you shall love, honor and respect her as you have me."
458.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false)

460.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
460.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

461.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
461.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

462.speaker: Narrator
462.text: In my hands, I clutched a set of test results. With the royal baby's birth on the horizon, Lucita had insisted on visiting Rizia's most advanced laboratories to determine the gender.

463.speaker: Narrator
463.text: I read the words once more: "Sex: Male."

464.speaker: Narrator
464.text: Inside the palace, a camera crew was setting up, ready to film our statement announcing my new successor.

465.speaker: Narrator
465.text: In her hands, she clutched the set of test results I'd just given her. She read the words once more, as if repeating them would undo their truth.

467.speaker: Narrator
467.text: I heard a clatter from inside the palace. A camera crew was setting up equipment, preparing to film my official announcement of my new successor.

469.speaker: Lucita Azaro
469.text: "I hope you're not too put out, Your Highness."

470.speaker: Lucita Azaro
470.text: "Really, I'm so impressed with the intelligence and poise you've shown these past years..."

471.speaker: Lucita Azaro
471.text: "My son will be lucky to have you as a role model."

472.speaker: Narrator
472.text: She embraced Vina. My daughter hugged her back somewhat uncomfortably.

478.speaker: Narrator
478.text: Lucita turned towards me, as radiant as I'd ever seen her.

482.speaker: Player_Romus
482.text: "I am a man of my word, my love. I hope your house will be satisfied with this."

485.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
485.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false

486.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
486.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false) == false

487.speaker: Player_Romus
487.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false

488.speaker: Player_Romus
488.text: "A new king of Rizia. My legacy is secured."

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "I hope Vina doesn't hate me... wherever she is."
492.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false) == false

493.speaker: Lucita Azaro
493.text: "You made the right choice. For everyone."

494.speaker: Lucita Azaro
494.text: "Forget about my house for a moment."

498.speaker: Player_Romus
498.text: "I broke a promise just now. I hope your house is satisfied."

499.speaker: Narrator
499.text: She reached beneath the folds of her gown and unholstered her dagger.

500.speaker: Lucita Azaro
500.text: "I once swore I would never give all of myself to anyone. That I would always keep a part of my heart protected."

503.speaker: Lucita Azaro
503.text: "You have me, King Romus. All of me."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "And if I *hadn't* named our son-to-be my successor?"

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "It's about time you stopped carrying that thing around. Someone could get hurt."

506.speaker: Player_Romus
506.text: "You should keep that. The Crown still has enemies, as you well know."

507.speaker: Player_Romus
507.text: "I'll have you right here on this sofa if you keep up that talk."

511.speaker: Lucita Azaro
511.text: "Shh. The TV crew's still right here."

513.speaker: Lucita Azaro
513.text: "A moot question. You never would have done that."

515.speaker: Player_Romus
515.text: "We're closer than ever to our goal. Building the strongest, most secure kingdom Merkopa has ever seen."

520.speaker: Player_Romus
520.text: "A pity he'll never get to reign the way I and my father did. But that was what I signed my family up for."

524.speaker: Player_Romus
524.text: "Without the pressure to rule hanging over his head, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} might be able to have a normal childhood. I'm almost jealous of him."

525.speaker: Player_Romus
525.text: "I'm starting to think that I am not the king from the prophecies. But {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} will be."

529.speaker: Player_Romus
529.text: "The power of God runs through our son's veins, just as it does mine."

530.speaker: Player_Romus
530.text: "I hope I'll be a better father this time around."
530.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"]

532.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
532.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"]

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "I wish I could see what kind of king he's going to be."

537.speaker: Lucita Azaro
537.text: "The Toras-Azaro dynasty will not be stopped."

539.speaker: Lucita Azaro
539.text: "Then I suppose we should stay on his good side once he's born."

542.speaker: Lucita Azaro
542.text: "You could always abdicate... joking, of course."

543.speaker: Player_Romus
543.text: "Sorry I didn't run his name by you first. Inspiration just struck me."

545.speaker: Narrator
545.text: I heard a faint, muffled sob coming from the direction of the terrace.
545.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false

546.speaker: Narrator
546.text: Vina and I stood on the back terrace of my palace in Monqiz.
546.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

550.speaker: Vina Toras
550.text: "Need I remind you that you *promised* I would succeed you? What's going to happen if you break your word?"
550.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Vina_HeirApparent"] == true)

553.speaker: Vina Toras
553.text: "You know me. You know what kind of monarch I'll be. Can you say the same of a fetus who'll spend his life under the influence of the Azaros?"
553.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Vina_HeirApparent"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PalesOwnership_Azaros"] == true) == false)

560.speaker: Player_Romus
560.text: "I promised the Azaros that my son would be granted his birthright. If I break that promise, it'll be both our heads on the chopping block."

564.speaker: Vina Toras
564.text: "What?! How could you promise both things at the same time?"

565.speaker: Player_Romus
565.text: "The Azaros aren't a bad influence. I'm proud our houses are united."

566.speaker: Vina Toras
566.text: "United for now. How long until they take over?"

570.speaker: Vina Toras
570.text: "You gave the Azaros Pales. Do you have to give them the throne, too?"
570.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Vina_HeirApparent"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.PalesOwnership_Azaros"] == true)

574.speaker: Vina Toras
574.text: "I am -- was-- the Duchess of Valenqiris. The only person House Toras loves more than me is Rico."
574.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true) == false)

576.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
576.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true

577.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
577.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true) == false

578.speaker: Player_Romus
578.text: "House Toras doesn't concern me. If they try anything, I'll punish them even worse than before."
578.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true

582.speaker: Player_Romus
582.text: "House Sazon doesn't concern me. If they try anything, I'll punish them even worse than before."
582.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseSazon_Conquered"] == true)

583.speaker: Vina Toras
583.text: "You cannot enforce your will through oppression forever, Father. Sooner or later, you'll have to face the consequences."

590.speaker: Player_Romus
590.text: "I gave the Azaros Pales. I'm not about to give them the throne too."

591.speaker: Vina Toras
591.text: "Yes, they should be happy with their expanded territory."

592.speaker: Lucita Azaro
592.text: "Go talk to her. She'll be all right in the end."

594.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
594.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false

595.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
595.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false) == false

596.speaker: Narrator
596.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FuneralHappened"] == false) == false

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "We've talked enough already. I don't owe her any more explanations."

599.speaker: Player_Romus
599.text: "Yes, I'll go see her. You should rest."

601.speaker: Narrator
601.text: Leaving Lucita on the divan, I pushed open the door to the terrace.

602.speaker: Narrator
602.text: Vina was standing by the railing, her back to me.

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "You never really wanted the job anyway, right?"

607.speaker: Player_Romus
607.text: "Why did you have to run out like that? It was embarrassing."

608.speaker: Player_Romus
608.text: "I didn't have another choice. I'm sorry."

609.speaker: Player_Romus
609.text: "Duchess of Valenqiris. Not a bad title."

619.speaker: Player_Romus
619.text: "The Prime Minister's wife. Not a bad title."
619.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_PrimeMinister_Manus"] == true)

620.speaker: Player_Romus
620.text: "Grand Duchess of Pales. Not a bad title."
620.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_PrimeMinister_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true)

621.speaker: Player_Romus
621.text: "I'll make it up to you, Vina. I promise."
621.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_PrimeMinister_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false)

623.speaker: Narrator
623.text: She turned around. A single tear streamed down her cheek.

624.speaker: Vina Toras
624.text: "I'm happy for you, Father. Really, I am."

626.speaker: Narrator
626.text: My wife stayed frozen in place, staring at me in anger and disbelief.

631.speaker: Narrator
631.text: She walked off without another word.

632.speaker: Vina Toras
632.text: "I really must be going. Excuse me."

633.speaker: Lucita Azaro
633.text: "Never mind. I'm not about to give you parenting advice."

634.speaker: Narrator
634.text: She was 26 now -- a full-grown woman with a husband and a life of her own.

638.speaker: Narrator
638.text: She was 26 now -- a full-grown woman with a life of her own.

639.speaker: Narrator
639.text: But when I looked at her, I saw the toddler who kept wandering into my study even with an army of caretakers to keep her occupied.

640.speaker: Narrator
640.text: The child whom I'd consoled after her mother's death, even when it meant fighting back my own grief.

644.speaker: Narrator
644.text: The child whom I'd consoled after her mother's death, hiding the fact that I felt nothing myself.

645.speaker: Narrator
645.text: The teenager who'd lost herself for hours in history books, coming down to supper with questions my mother and I couldn't answer.

649.speaker: Narrator
649.text: The daughter I'd almost lost -- twice.

651.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
651.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] < 0

652.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
652.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] < 0) == false

653.speaker: Narrator

654.speaker: Narrator
